rationale: MFIC has gapped up 22% on no news, is trading at 96.9% of its intraday range at the session high with an extremely tight ATR of $0.021, suggesting the move is exhausted and momentum is stalling. The risk/reward for a long at the top of a massive gap-up with no catalyst is poor, and shorting a stock with this kind of unusual volume (18.49x relative volume) and potential corporate event driving the gap carries significant squeeze risk. With no clear mechanical edge in either direction and an already negative P&L today, skipping preserves capital.
